voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Bermuda, January eighteen eighty. The training ship Atalanta sailed for England, with about two hundred and eighty aboard.
Most were young trainees. The ship never arrived. None of them was ever seen again.
Wreckage was reported near the Azores. None of it was ever proven to be hers.
A former crewman said she rolled dangerously. No trace of her was ever found.
Theories include a storm, and a ship too unstable to sail. More than a century on, no wreck has ever been identified.
